usedFor: beatandraise reads SEC EDGAR filings; HubSpot is your CRM. A “New Filing” or “New Insider Transaction” for a company you follow can open a deal with “Create Deal”, so sales sees the signal.

bestTemplate.name: “New Filing” in beatandraise, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: You can filter by company, form type or 8-K item, so only filings that signal a real opportunity create a deal.

watchOut: Both beatandraise triggers run daily, so a filing shows up in HubSpot up to a day late. Filter by form type or the same company can fill your pipeline with deals.
